# Mem0 memory-benchmarks prompt files

Copied without modification from https://github.com/mem0ai/memory-benchmarks
at revision 4b61c5d31b9c668a12b4f5e78064248a02c82d2b:

- `locomo_prompts.py` = `benchmarks/locomo/prompts.py`,
  SHA-256 8ebac1ef60e9ab5caf99079fdaac038b85472e81491ed35e2d2655f3927c76c2
- `beam_prompts.py` = `benchmarks/beam/prompts.py`,
  SHA-256 a1c2a4822898411f90ab2915a72d2b2031f97437bdcc1b3ac2008fe93653267b

Only the judge prompts are used, for parity with Mem0's evaluation. The
answer-generation prompts in these files are Mem0's retrieval-based
answerer and are not used.
